description: The 2024 NFL season, from the August 1, 2024 Hall of Fame Game through Super Bowl LIX on February 9, 2025.
notes: Includes games between NFL clubs: preseason, regular season, and playoffs. Excludes Pro Bowl flag football and skills events.
Dates use the America/New_York timezone. Home and away identify designated teams, including neutral-site games.
The week field is 0 for the Hall of Fame Game, 1-3 for preseason, 1-18 for the regular season, and 19-22 for the playoffs.
Score fields are integer final scores. game_id is the ESPN event ID. Team abbreviations follow ESPN (LAR and WSH).
All 314 distinct regular-season/playoff games across these two datasets were cross-checked between nflverse and ESPN with no score discrepancies.

sources.name: nflverse / nfldata game data
sources.use: Regular-season and playoff dates, rounds, and final scores.

sources.name: ESPN score data, 2024
sources.use: Preseason final scores; team names; cross-check of regular-season and playoff scores.

sources.name: ESPN score data, 2025
sources.use: Cross-check of games played in January and February 2025.
